Common Questions

Frequently Asked

What's a chattel mortgage?

A chattel mortgage is a popular business vehicle finance option that allows you to take ownership of the asset while the lender holds a mortgage as security. Depending on your circumstances, there may be tax considerations.

What is a novated lease?

A novated lease allows vehicle finance — and, if included, eligible running costs — to be managed through your pre-tax salary. This structure may offer budgeting benefits and potential tax considerations depending on your employment and personal circumstances.

Do you offer low doc loans for self-employed businesses?

Low doc vehicle loans are a business finance option available to business owners and self-employed applicants who may not have traditional income documentation. Lending criteria vary between providers, and alternative verification methods may be accepted depending on your circumstances. All applications are subject to lender approval and eligibility requirements.
